3. This delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo(ctx, create)` (line 113 in `store/memo.go`)
4. The driver is selected in `/bench/repo/store/db/db.go` via a switch statement on `profile.Driver` (line 18-20), which routes to `sqlite.NewDB()` when the driver is "sqlite"
